purpose: machine-readable map for automated agents and tooling

assembly.policy: integrate distinct application capabilities by domain; do not blindly merge branch history

branch_families.feat: application capabilities; inspect unique commits and files before integration
branch_families.fix: repairs and hardening; integrate when they add distinct behavior
branch_families.reconcile: integration/reconciliation work; preserve unique commits and resolve overlap
branch_families.stabilize: stabilization work; stale tips already contained in main were normalized
branch_families.merge: merge-oriented work; currently contains unique commits and is not auto-merged
branch_families.tmp: temporary work; stale tips already contained in main were normalized

machine_rules: Read this manifest before modifying the repository.
Prefer package-local imports over root-level coupling.
Keep heavy subsystems out of skeleton/__init__.py.
Use integration/app-consolidation as the assembly workspace.
Integrate behavior and files, not branch names.
Record every structural integration decision here and in machine/README.md.
Do not discard branches with unique commits without reviewing their file-level changes.
